Wait, looking closer at the "Experimental Context Rule": Metadata values must refer to the biological material that was ACTUALLY ANALYSED BY MASS SPECTROMETRY.

The Caco-2 cells were used for immunofluorescence and Western blots, but the MS was performed on HEK293T. HEK293T is a human embryonic kidney cell line, not a colorectal carcinoma line.
